- Net terms: Standard hosted seats are quoted Net 30. We can propose Net 45 for a 5% contract fee or Net 60 with a 7% fee (one-time gross-up on first invoice). If Novamed prefers no fee, we can require a purchase order-backed prepayment for the activation month.
- Invoice routing & PO: Confirmed — route invoices to finance-emea@novamed.com and include Novamed-PO-6453 on each invoice.

Attached is our suggested order form redline (OrderForm_Redline_v2.docx) showing: a) an explicit invoice recipient block, b) VAT reverse-charge clause option A, and c) two payment cadence options (Net 45 w/ 5% fee, Net 60 w/ 7% fee) for your procurement team to pick.

- Ben: if Novamed opts for Net 60 with fee, can you confirm commercial OK so I can lock pricing?
- Sarah: can you share the VAT ID and confirm the billing entity name?

Ben / Jonas — thanks for the ping and for the redline. I'm attaching our legal pass (OrderForm_redline_legal.pdf) and summarizing the position below so we have a single authoritative thread for procurement and sales.

Position summary:
1) VAT reverse-charge: Acceptable for EU entities only when:
   - Novamed provides a valid EU VAT registration number and
   - The order form names the specific Novamed legal entity that holds that VAT number and matches the invoice payee.
   - Invoice must include the VAT ID and the reference "Reverse-charge VAT — Article 194" (or local equivalent) in the invoice footer.
   Rationale: this avoids exposure if the customer later claims reverse-charge without the correct registration.

2) Net terms & commercial adjustment:
   - We do not offer Net 60 as standard without a commercial adjustment. Acceptable paths:
     a) Net 45 with a 5% surcharge applied to recurring invoices for the first 3 months; or
     b) Net 60 with a 7% surcharge applied to the first invoice only (gross-up).
   - Alternative: Net 60 with one-month prepay (applies as credit to the second month) if Novamed refuses surcharge.
   - Please avoid offering Net 60 without either a surcharge or prepay — finance/legal credit risk policies prevent open Net 60 on first-time corporate customers.

3) Invoice routing & PO:
   - We will accept invoices to finance-emea@novamed.com with PO on the invoice. Please include the entity's remit details in the order form so our billing system emits the correct legal payee.

4) Contract language & redline attachments:
   - See attached PDF for tracked legal edits. Key required edits: explicit billing entity field, VAT evidence clause, and a narrow tax indemnity that preserves our right to seek reimbursement for VAT we are forced to collect.

Next steps and asks for sales/procurement:
• Jonas: confirm which commercial option Novamed prefers (Net 45 w/5%; Net 60 w/7%; or Net 60 w/1-month prepay).
• Ben: once Novamed picks, confirm pricing change and I'll sign off on the legal language.
• Jonas / Sarah: please send the certified VAT ID and the exact legal entity name that should be on the order form.
• I will prepare the DocuSign envelope after we have the selected commercial path and the VAT evidence.
